name: Haven
description: FBI agent Audrey Parker arrives in the small town of Haven, Maine to solve a murder and soon discovers the town's many secrets—which also hold the key to unlocking the mysteries of her lost past.

Welcome to Haven
videos.overview: FBI agent Audrey Parker travels to the town of Haven to investigate the death of an escaped prisoner who fled to his hometown. She soon discovers the man's death is merely the tip of a very large iceberg of supernatural phenomena.

videos.title: Butterfly
videos.overview: Audrey remains in Haven to investigate her mother's connection to the Colorado Kid, but ends up working with Nathan to determine the cause of a mysterious series of incidents that involve butterflies and otherworldly phenomena centered on a angry reverend, his passive daughter, and her foster son.

videos.title: Harmony
videos.overview: A plague of insanity strikes at a local hospital, causing the doctors to go insane... and the patients to become normal. Audrey and Nathan seek to discover the cause before it spreads further.

videos.title: Consumed
videos.overview: Haven is stricken by a mysterious plague when animals and plants alike are destroyed by exposure to hydrochloric acid with no discernible source.

videos.title: Ball and Chain
videos.overview: Young men in Haven start aging at an accelerated rate, and Audrey and Nathan attempt to find the source.

videos.title: Fur
videos.overview: A series of fatal animal attacks lead Audrey and Nathan to investigate a local woman who supports animal rights. However, they soon discover that while she may not be Troubled, the person responsible is... and Chief Wournos is the next target.

videos.title: Sketchy
videos.overview: Two mysterious assaults involve crooked businessmen, and sketching charcoal is found at each crime scene. However, the boy the officers suspect is responsible becomes a third victim, leaving them to pursue a new line of investigation.

videos.title: Ain't No Sunshine
videos.overview: Audrey and Nathan learn of a ghost story that wanders the Haven clinic and takes the lives of sick people before their time.

videos.title: As You Were
videos.overview: Audrey's surprise birthday party at a local hotel goes awry when a shapeshifter stalks the partygoers, and nobody knows who can be trusted.

videos.title: The Hand You're Dealt
videos.overview: Nathan and Audrey investigate a series of murders, but the prime suspect insists that she's trying to stop the real killer. Meanwhile, in the aftermath of Duke's revelation, Audrey continues to investigate the Colorado Kid mystery involving her mother.

videos.title: The Trial of Audrey Parker
videos.overview: Audrey joins in a friendly game of poker aboard Duke's ship, but the two new players soon lock everyone up and try to find a box that Duke is smuggling. Meanwhile, Audrey's boss arrives in town and demands answers.

videos.title: Resurfacing
videos.overview: Audrey and Nathan investigate when a gust of wind seemingly throws a woman into a wall following an argument, and the FBI agent suspects some children may have telekinetic powers.

videos.title: Spiral
videos.overview: As the mysterious cracks spread throughout Haven at an increasing rate, a mysterious criminal returns to Haven and Audrey discovers the secrets of her past and her mother's.

videos.title: A Tale of Two Audreys
videos.overview: Haven is beset by biblical plagues. Duke continues looking for information on the tattoo, with a little help from his past. Audrey and Nathan check out Audrey II, and try to figure out what to do about Chief Wuornos.

videos.title: Fear & Loathing
videos.overview: The residents of Haven have their worst fears come to life while Nathan's "trouble" seems to vanish.

videos.title: Love Machine
videos.overview: The town's docks start attacking people while the other Audrey Parker probes Audrey's identity crisis.

videos.title: Sparks and Recreation
videos.overview: When a deadly series of electrocutions occur around town, Audrey and Nathan investigate the cause

videos.title: Roots
videos.overview: A wedding at an isolated estate turns deadly for the guests when the site becomes sealed off and something attacks from within.

videos.title: Audrey Parker's Day Off
videos.overview: A single day keeps repeating for Audrey, who finds a deadly accident linked to the phenomenon.

videos.title: The Tides That Bind
videos.overview: A drowning case exposes a secretive family compound on the outskirts of Haven, from which children have disappeared under mysterious circumstances.

videos.title: Friend or Faux
videos.overview: A banker hides a dark secret that connects him to a killer hiding in Haven. Meanwhile, Duke helps a young runaway and Nathan discovers that his job is at risk.

videos.title: Lockdown
videos.overview: When a Troubled individual unleashes a rotting plague inside the police station, the new Chief orders a quarantine... trapping Audrey and the others inside. Meanwhile, Duke confronts Evi about her betrayal of him.

videos.title: Who, What, Where, Wendigo?
videos.overview: Audrey and Nathan take a search party into the woods to find a missing boy whose disappearance may be connected to the Troubles, and receive some unwanted help from Driscoll.

videos.title: Business as Usual
videos.overview: With Nathan's help, Audrey finally locates Lucy Ripley and goes to confront her. Meanwhile, Duke and Dwight join forces to discover what Duke's father Simon left for his son.

videos.title: Sins of the Fathers
videos.overview: Haven's dead rise from their graves to reveal the town's secrets... and those of Audrey, Nathan, and Duke.

videos.title: Silent Night
videos.overview: Audrey is the only one who realizes that there are Christmas decorations in July that no one else finds unusual. The out-of-season decorations are only a prelude to the bizarre bisection of a surfer and a series of escalating disappearances of people who no one can remember except Audrey.
While Nathan and Duke set aside their differences and try to find Audrey, a Troubled individual is plagued by alien abductors.

videos.title: Stay
videos.overview: Naked savages wander the streets of Haven. While Nathan and Audrey try to determine who they are and where they've come from, Duke convinces the Teagues to let him see the old newspapers and determine who the mysterious "Hunter" is and how he's connected to Audrey.

videos.title: The Farmer
videos.overview: Audrey and Nathan encounter a bizarre series of deaths suggesting a serial killer, with a unique “trouble”, is at work in Haven. Meanwhile, a Boston cop tries linking the town's latest body to similar cases.

videos.title: Over My Head
videos.overview: Audrey and Nathan investigate a series of strange incidents where the only common factor is water. Meanwhile, Duke insists on tailing along on the officers' investigation, while the Teagues do some digging on Tommy's background.

videos.title: Double Jeopardy
videos.overview: A vigilante stalks Haven's criminals, rendering poetic justice. Meanwhile, Nathan grows closer to Jordan as he attempts to infiltrate the Guard, and Audrey learns more about the bolt-gun killer that is stalking her.

videos.title: Real Estate
videos.overview: On Halloween night, Audrey, Nathan and Duke become trapped inside a haunted house.

videos.title: Magic Hour (1)
videos.overview: While Audrey and Duke track down the Colorado Kid's parents, Nathan and Tommy investigate Troubled incidents involving the resurrection of dead for payment.

videos.title: Magic Hour (2)
videos.overview: Audrey and Duke return from Colorado. Audrey, Duke and Tommy try to find the woman with the resurrection touch. Meanwhile, the Teagues realizes that the Bolt Gun Killer has tricked them and track the murderer to his real target.

videos.title: Sarah
videos.overview: A Troubled war veteran sends Duke and Nathan back to 1955. Meanwhile, in the present Audrey tries to deal with an altered timeline where Driscoll's men have taken over the town.

videos.title: Burned
videos.overview: While helping a little girl whose "trouble" is the ability to make people do what she wants Audrey also gathers clues to the identity of the Bolt Gun Killer.

videos.title: Last Goodbyes
videos.overview: When Haven falls into a deep sleep, Audrey must work with the only other person awake in town. Meanwhile, more questions arise about the Bolt Gun Killer.

videos.title: Reunion
videos.overview: Nathan and Duke try to help Audrey search for a troubled killer after a string of murders take place at the Haven High School.

videos.title: Thanks for the Memories
videos.overview: As Audrey grapples with her fate; at the same time she, Nathan and Duke prepare for a showdown with the Bolt Gun Killer.

videos.title: Fallout
videos.overview: Duke is ejected from the barn and rescued by a young woman; Audrey is missing and the Troubles are worse than ever.

videos.title: Survivors
videos.overview: As charred bodies are uncovered around Haven, Duke must refocus Nathan to solve the case at hand.

videos.title: Bad Blood
videos.overview: Nathan and Dwight race to search for the trouble behind a series of exsanguinated corpses; Duke must convince his half-brother to leave Haven before he learns the truth of the Crocker family trouble.

videos.title: Lost and Found
videos.overview: Nathan and Dwight investigate missing children linked to an ancient legend, while Duke tries to find Audrey by focusing Jennifer's trouble.

videos.title: The New Girl
videos.overview: Lexie, the new girl in town, joins Nathan on a hunt for a deadly trouble that changes its victims' personalities.

videos.title: Countdown
videos.overview: Nathan, Duke, and Lexie find themselves in a race against time to find the troubled person responsible for turning people hard as stone.

videos.title: Lay Me Down
videos.overview: Nathan and Lexie hunt a trouble that attacks Haven's citizens in their nightmares; Duke deals with the nightmare his brother has become.

videos.title: Crush
videos.overview: A deadly sea trouble threatens to crush the town.

videos.title: William
videos.overview: Audrey believes the thugs from the barn are holding William as a hostage.

videos.title: The Trouble with Troubles
videos.overview: Audrey finds herself in a different Haven where troubles don't exist.

videos.title: Shot in the Dark
videos.overview: The Seekers follow a monster to Haven; their presence threatens to reveal the town's troubles to the entire world.

videos.title: When the Bough Breaks
videos.overview: William is determined to convince Audrey of the truth behind her origins; a seemingly unstoppable curse is unleashed.

videos.title: The Lighthouse
videos.overview: Audrey fights to remain herself as she tracks down William to sever their ethereal connection

videos.title: See No Evil
videos.overview: Audrey, Nathan and Duke's victory over William feels hollow as they deal with the aftermath of Duke on death's door, Mara in control of Audrey's body, and a strange trouble supernaturally silencing citizens all over town.

videos.title: Speak No Evil
videos.overview: Duke struggles to accept Jennifer's death; Nathan searches for some shred of Audrey in Mara's cruel personality; Dwight shoulders the heavy burden of holding Haven together.

videos.title: Spotlight
videos.overview: Nathan makes a desperate play to protect Mara from the furious citizens of Haven, leaving Dwight and Duke to deal with a deadly trouble that threatens to burn the town to the ground.

videos.title: Much Ado About Mara
videos.overview: Dwight and Nathan clash over what to do about Mara; Dwight wants her to end the troubles at any cost, but Nathan is convinced that Audrey is in there.

videos.title: The Old Switcheroo (1)
videos.overview: When Vince and Dave travel to North Carolina, their probing of Dave's past uncovers a body-swapping problem back in Haven.

videos.title: The Old Switcheroo (2)
videos.overview: Mara capitalizes on the latest crisis, forcing Duke and Nathan to roll the dice to get Audrey back in a dangerous gamble.

videos.title: Nowhere Man
videos.overview: A paranormal trouble tears Audrey and Nathan apart just after they were reunited.

videos.title: Exposure
videos.overview: Audrey must call in outside help as she is no longer immune to the troubles and Nathan may be lost forever.

videos.title: Morbidity
videos.overview: When Audrey and dozens of Haven citizens are affected by a mysterious illness, the symptoms threaten to expose Haven’s secrets to a dangerous newcomer.

videos.title: Mortality
videos.overview: Haven’s heroes are torn over how to deal with an inquisitive CDC scientist, who could expose the secret of the troubles to the world, but may be hiding her own dark agenda.

videos.title: Reflections
videos.overview: Duke’s roiling troubles and a new threat to Audrey force them each to seek the help of potentially dangerous allies.

videos.title: Chemistry
videos.overview: When a trouble drives Haven’s citizens to pursue their more primal desires, it takes everyone to keep Haven from coming unglued-distracting them from the menacing storm that is brewing.

videos.title: Chosen
videos.overview: As Mara'a endgame becomes clear, Nathan and Audrey pursue a plan to stop her once and for all.

videos.title: New World Order
videos.overview: Dwight struggles to maintain order when Duke's trouble wreaks havoc around town; at the same time, Audrey and Charlotte work together to drive away a mysterious fog that has everyone trapped in Haven.

videos.title: Power
videos.overview: Desperate conditions in Haven lead to a terrified population that's difficult for Dwight to maintain control over; at the same time, Nathan assembles a task force to restore power to the town; and Audrey tries to put an end to the trouble once and for all.

videos.title: The Trial of Nathan Wuornos
videos.overview: Dwight and Charlotte work to clear Nathan's name when the citizens of Haven put the lawman on trial. Hoping to buy them time, the brothers Teagues moderate the courtroom proceedings, while Audrey continues her quest to solve the darkness troubles.

videos.title: Enter Sandman
videos.overview: Dwight and Charlotte work on a way to free Audrey from the Sandman's stasis before he can trap her in his mind forever; at the same time, Duke tries to help Darkside Seeker Seth Byrne recover his memories of Haven.

videos.title: Wild Card
videos.overview: Charlotte and Audrey work on their new plan to eliminate the troubles, but something seems to be thwarting their attempts, and it's up to Nathan and Dwight to get to the bottom of it. Meanwhile, the Teagues brothers search for the mysterious serial killer who's stalking the streets of Haven.

videos.title: Perditus
videos.overview: Nathan receives otherworldly help as he works to track down a terrifying killer; and Duke reaches a crossroads after he has an alarming vision of Haven's future.

videos.title: Just Passing Through
videos.overview: Nathan and Vince travel back to the year 1983 in order to discover Croatoan's origins in Haven; at the same time, Duke finds himself in grave danger after being apprehended by a mysterious foe.

videos.title: Close to Home
videos.overview: Nathan encounters an old adversary after entering the terrible Void; Audrey and Duke deal with the threat of a newly troubled person who wants revenge; at the same time, Dwight tries to help Vince free Dave from Croatoan's grip.

videos.title: A Matter of Time
videos.overview: While Duke tries to convince Hallie to reopen the thinny, Nathan tries to escape from the Void where he and William are trapped. Meanwhile, Dave must consider making the ultimate sacrifice to stop Croatoan.

videos.title: Blind Spot
videos.overview: Plans for building a new barn are complicated when an old trouble brings the Haven Police Station to life. It's up to Audrey and Nathan to find a way to regain control, but their efforts are hampered when a mysterious killer leaves a wake of bodies right under their noses.

videos.title: The Widening Gyre
videos.overview: Nathan and Dwight race to rescue Audrey from Croatoan, but the consequences of Duke's dark destiny wreak havoc on their plans. Meanwhile, Vince contemplates an unusual sacrifice.

videos.title: Now
videos.overview: Hope of ending the troubles begins to fade as the heroes struggle to rebuild the Barn in the face of mounting obstacles. And while Dwight is tempted by a surprise gift, Nathan finds himself considering a devastating sacrifice.

videos.title: Forever
videos.overview: Nathan struggles to return to Haven as Dwight reconsiders his future in the series finale, which also finds Audrey coming to a terrifying decision about how she might finally save the town from Croatoan.
